title: Police Department
key_finding: The City maintains an official Melbourne Police Department page with headquarters, non-emergency contact information, and a city crime map updated daily.

title: MPD Launches Interactive Community Crime Map
key_finding: The City announced on June 5, 2025 that Melbourne Police Department launched an interactive crime map for reported crime in the City of Melbourne, confirming current active municipal policing operations.

title: Budget
key_finding: The city budget page includes police-department budget actions and Law Enforcement Trust Fund actions, supporting an active municipally funded police function.

title: County and Municipal Offense Data 2019
key_finding: FDLE lists Melbourne Police Department as a separate Brevard municipal law-enforcement row in 2019.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE lists Melbourne Police Department with a 2020 index total of 3,288 while separately listing Brevard County Sheriff's Office, West Melbourne Police Department, and Melbourne International Airport PD.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE still lists Melbourne Police Department in 2021 with a nonzero index total of 2,925, showing that the municipal reporting surface continued after 2020.

title: UCR Incident-Based Reports
key_finding: FDLE states that downloadable FIBRS Excel reports cover the 2021-2024 and 2025 Q1 reporting cycles, making this the most likely official post-2021 backfill surface for Melbourne Police Department.
